overview_description.description:
Glamera B2B2C:
SaaS platform to power beauty salons, spa, Gym and barber shops, to optimize sales, booking, marketing, inventory and HR.

Glamera White Label: 
Every service provider can create his own website, to help his customer in pre-booking his services. 

Glamera Pay: SoftPOS.

competitors_list.target_short_description: Phorest is salon and spa management software built for growth-focused premium businesses.
Fresha is a marketplace platform that allows users to find beauty, wellness, and self-care services nearby.
Mindbody is a wellness experience platform that allows clients to find and engage with fitness, beauty, and integrative health services.
Booksy is a booking platform that links local customers with professionals in the beauty, wellness, and health industries.
Zenoti is a provider of cloud-based software for the spa and salon industries.
Square is a technology company with a focus on financial services.

Meevo is a business management software provider for the beauty and wellness industry.

DaySmart is the leading provider of business management tools designed to make it easier for entrepreneurs to run and grow their businesses.

product.name: Reservations Management
product.description: A system to organize daily reservations and services with employees through an integrated calendar.

product.name: POS and Billing
product.description: A billing system that issues invoices in various formats and sizes, and supports multiple payment methods.

product.name: Financial Transactions
product.description: A feature to manage daily financial transactions, including opening and closing balances.

product.name: Customer Management
product.description: Tools to manage customer interactions, including communication through SMS and loyalty programs.

product.name: HR Management
product.description: Features to manage employee attendance, payroll, and overtime, linked to fingerprint devices.

product.name: Inventory Management
product.description: A system to record and track inventory transactions and movements between stores and branches.
